Our Black Forest Cake is a delightful treat made with chocolate sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with fresh cream, chocolate, cherries, and chocolate chips. It's topped with strawberry jello and is available in a minimum weight of 1 kg. The price is ₹1099.
